notes: Only the binary Sky-vs-Background experiment has numbers (Table I); the model configuration lists 'Output classes: 32' and Table II '5 bit (32 classes)', but no 32-class result is reported. How the TM is combined with the U-Net: every U-Net conv block is replaced by a CTM block = standard Conv2D preprocessing -> binarization phi (multiple thresholds) -> CTM2D producing integer votes cast to float; encoder CTM block + max pooling, decoder upsample + binarize + CTMRefine2D, concatenated with skip and fused by a 1x1 conv; output head is a CTM1x1 (per-class CTM heads, one-vs-rest Type I/II feedback per pixel), logits = alpha * votes. Batch norm and dropout are also used; the paper says Adam with lr/weight decay, which is not explained for non-differentiable CTMs. Internal inconsistencies: (1) split 367+92+233 = 692 vs 701 images, and 367 called 80% of training data; (2) conclusion says '86.43% mIoU with 52% memory reduction' while Tables III/IV give 31x/32x and Table I labels it IoU of the binary task; (3) loss eq. has lambda1 on Dice but Sec. III-B gives lambda1 = 0.7 (Focal); (4) 'Batch size 16 (effective batch size with gradient accumulation: 4)'; (5) 'The validation results using the test set is shown in Table I' - it is not stated which set early stopping/ReduceLROnPlateau monitor; (6) a referenced 'Table ??' (operation counts) is missing. The UNet baseline at 99.99% acc/IoU is as printed.
